senses.gloss: ch.<cite ref="M01651">same</cite> <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 37:26">Targ. Gen. XXXVII, 26</cite> <he>מה מ׳</he> (Y. <he>הניית מ׳</he>; h. taxt <he>מה בצע</he>).
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 21:30">Targ. Ex. XXI, 30</cite> (h. text <cite ref="K01048"><he>כֹּפֶר</he></cite>); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 15a:12">B. Kam. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>פלגא נזקא מ׳</he> the payment of ‘half-damage’ is considered as a due indemnity, opp. <cite ref="S01606"><he>קנסא</he></cite> penalty.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 108a:10">Ib. 108ᵃ</cite> <he>תרי גווני מ׳</he> two kinds of indemnity (for the same action); <cite ref="Bava Kamma 108a:10">ib.</cite> <he>תרי ממונא</he> two indemnities; a. fr.
